egress.terms: "Unmetered Traffic" with "1 GBit/s" port, on both the DE and FI product pages. This is the cleanest egress term among the records read — a port speed with no counter and no published fair-use threshold.

tooling: rsync/Borg/restic over SSH. No S3, no WebDAV.
chaining: Archive/backup leg only. No object API means it cannot serve the hot set or back a Cloudflare origin directly.
limits_note: No WebDAV, no S3. Capacity ladder stops at 2 TB per box on the page I opened — for 20 TB you would need ten boxes, which is operationally ugly even if the per-TB price holds.
reliability_note: Small host (NetDynamics LLC), advertises 256 GB RAM Xeon E5-1650v3 storage nodes with RAID-6 and unmetered 1 Gbit/s. The LET50% coupon is quoted by the provider's own Host Rep account on LET, which is a stronger source than a third-party coupon site — but I could not observe it applied at checkout without an order.
